Subject: Change to remit bank & legal payee name (Northbridge)

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Quick note from Northbridge AP — we are consolidating two operating entities into a single legal payee (Northbridge Holdings LLC) and moving ACH to a new treasury account. Effective for new invoices dated on/after 2026-07-01, please remit to the new bank (details attached on the ACH form).

Attachments: northbridge_new_ach_form.pdf, northbridge_w9_signed.pdf

A couple of clarifications:
- This is a bookkeeping/legal-entity consolidation only; our primary purchasing contact remains the same (Diego Ramirez).
- We do NOT expect retroactive reissuance of invoices, but AP may request the vendor record name be updated for future POs/invoices.

Can you confirm next steps on your side for vendor record changes and whether any PO re-mapping is required?

Thanks,
Diego Ramirez
Sr. AP Manager, Northbridge LLC

Thanks Diego — sending to procurement + finance for verification. A couple quick questions to help us process the change cleanly:

1) Can you confirm the EIN/TIN on the attached W-9 is the consolidated entity EIN? If it differs, please include documentation noting the effective date.
2) Will Northbridge require POs issued before 2026-07-01 to be reissued to the new payee name, or will you accept the originals and pay them under your old ledger?
3) We typically require a signed vendor change request from an authorized AP contact; the ACH form helps but we also need a short vendor-authorized email or DocuSign envelope approving the change for our audit trail.

Marissa / Karthik — tagging you for intake: once Diego confirms the EIN and provides the signed authorization, can Procurement initiate the vendor record update and create a pending change ticket for Finance? Please confirm expected lead time so I can share with the vendor.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
